verdict.rationale: Cursor documents MCP client support for connecting the agent to external tools and data sources, including one-click marketplace installs with OAuth and custom JSON-configured servers. It also has first-party integrations with Slack and Linear, and cloud agents and automations can be triggered from Slack and Linear events. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Jira or Google Drive connectors (these are only implied via generic MCP), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow-tool context integration.
